decision: Freeze the existing 192/32/96 train/dev/test assignment without reassignment and use it for all paper-facing training and evaluation.
claim_boundary: The frozen split guarantees disjoint exact-image SHA-256 connected components across train, dev, and test. It does not claim detection of every visually related scene after crop, resize, re-encoding, or an unseen viewpoint.
retrain_rule: Any later change to annotations.jsonl, split_manifest.csv, train_group_ids.csv, or their recorded SHA-256 values invalidates adapters and evaluation results and requires a full rerun.
